visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short dark hair, wearing a green and white checkered short-sleeved shirt over a white tank top, stands outdoors. He looks directly at the camera, talking with animated facial expressions and moving his mouth clearly. Behind him is a paved road and a large green field under a bright, overcast sky. Yellow text captions appear at the top and bottom of the frame. (2) From a high-angle drone perspective, the man is seen running away from the side of a road into a large, brownish-green grassy field. A light green scooter is parked on the road's edge. He holds a smartphone in his right hand as he runs towards the center of the vast field. The lighting is natural and flat under a cloudy sky. (3) The shot changes to a close-up selfie view of the man as he runs, smiling broadly and looking into the camera. He is in the middle of the field with dry, yellowed grass stretching behind him. His green patterned shirt moves as he runs, and his expression is one of pure excitement and joy. (4) In another high-angle wide shot, the man appears as a small figure running across a large expanse of green grass with some brown patches. The road he started from and the green scooter are visible in the distance. The background shows some distant buildings and a horizon line under a soft, diffused light. (5) A low-angle close-up focuses on the man's feet as he runs across the dry grass. He is wearing black sandals and white shorts. The camera follows the rapid movement of his legs and feet, capturing the texture of the field surface as he moves quickly. (6) The drone shot shows the man stopping in a lush green area of the field. He stands with his back to the camera, then turns and spreads his arms wide, looking up at the sky. The vastness of the green landscape surrounds him, stretching towards a distant shoreline. (7) Back to a selfie perspective, the man spins the camera around himself while laughing with his mouth wide open. His face is the central focus, appearing very happy against a background of the field and the sky. The camera movement is dynamic and shaky, reflecting his energetic motion. (8) The camera pulls back into an extreme long shot, revealing the entire landscape including the winding road, the man in the field, and the blue sea with several small islands in the distance. A logo with Traditional Chinese text and a play button icon appears at the bottom center.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to capture and share the raw excitement and sense of liberation the creator feels when encountering a vast green field during travel. By combining energetic physical movement (running) and joyful vocal expressions with expansive drone cinematography, it creates a sense of immersive freedom for the viewer.
